components.Courses.CourseFaq.heading: Answers to the questions students ask first.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.intro: How enrollment, materials, live quizzes and teaching on Darasaone work day to day.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.helpBody: Our team answers in English and Swahili, usually within one working day.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.g1.a: Darasaone is a bilingual Islamic learning platform where teachers publish course material and students enroll to study, discuss and be assessed.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.g2.q: Do I need an account to enroll?
components.Courses.CourseFaq.g2.a: Yes. An account keeps your enrolled courses, quiz results, progress and notifications together in your dashboard.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.g3.a: English and Swahili run side by side across the platform, and courses carry titles and summaries in both languages.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.g4.q: Can I study from a phone?
components.Courses.CourseFaq.g4.a: Yes. Every page is built mobile first, so lessons, quizzes and discussion work on a phone as well as a laptop.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.s1.q: What material comes with a course?
components.Courses.CourseFaq.s1.a: Teachers publish video and audio lessons, books, textbooks, notes and images inside the course library, and you can take them with you.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.s2.a: Your teacher opens a timed quiz for the course, you answer within the window, and your score and review appear immediately.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.s3.q: Can I ask questions during a course?
components.Courses.CourseFaq.s3.a: Each course has its own chat and comments where you can ask, answer and react beside the lesson you are studying.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.s4.a: Your dashboard shows your learning path per course, lessons completed, quiz results and any new notification from your teacher.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.t1.a: Yes. Teachers with recognised grounding in their subject can apply, then publish a structured course with their own material.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.t2.q: What can I upload as a teacher?
components.Courses.CourseFaq.t2.a: Videos, audio recitations, books, textbooks, images and notes, organised lesson by lesson inside one course.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.t3.q: Do I keep ownership of my material?
components.Courses.CourseFaq.t3.a: Your material stays yours. Darasaone hosts and delivers it to your enrolled students and never resells it elsewhere.
components.Courses.CourseFaq.t4.q: Can I teach in Swahili only?
components.Courses.CourseFaq.t4.a: You can teach in Swahili, English or both. We encourage bilingual titles and summaries so more students can find your course.
